November, 2023

Author: S.N. Pathak
Bench: S.N.Pathak
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi

 Prabhat Kumar Poddar ... P
 Vs.
 The State of Jharkhand & Ors. ... Resp

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Dr. Justice S.N.Pathak For the Petitioner : Mr. Amar Kumar Sinha,
Advocate For the Resp.-State : Mrs. Vandana Singh, Sr. Sc-Iii
-----------
10/ 06.11.2023

In view of order and direction of this Court though counter affidavit and supplementary counter affidavit has been filed but it has not been brought on record whether the petitioner has been paid any fair compensation as per the Act, 2013.
Learned counsel for the petitioner very fairly submits that land was acquired in the year 2017 after following the procedure of law.

Learned counsel for the respondents-State very fairly submits that in view of the order of this court,
the supplementary counter affidavit has been filed.

Admittedly the State is in possession of the said land, constructions have been completed but petitioner has not been compensated yet due to some formalities which are yet to be carried out by the respondents.
This Court fails to understand that as per the law, the petitioner whose land has been acquired by the respondents-State has to be compensated well before acquisition of the said land.
Almost six years have passed, what are the formalities which stopped the respondents from extending the benefits of compensation is yet not known to the Court.

The respondents are directed to complete the entire formalities whatsoever and take immediate steps for making payment of fair compensation to the petitioner within a period of twelve weeks from the date of receipt of the copy of this order.

Let it be made clear, if an affidavit to that effect has not been filed regarding payment of compensation, the respondent nos.2 and 6 shall remain physically present before this Court on the Prabhat Kumar Poddar vs The State Of Jharkhand & Ors on 6 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158974463/
